item.title: "Old Friend, It's Time for You to Return Home"... The Resolute Order from President Syngman Rhee Across the Pacific (“자네, 이제 귀국하게”… 태평양 건너 이승만 대통령의 단호한 지시)
item.description:
"Old Friend, It's Time for You to Return Home"... The Resolute Order from President Syngman Rhee Across the Pacific (“자네, 이제 귀국하게”… 태평양 건너 이승만 대통령의 단호한 지시)

The next morning, Paik Sun-yup visited the U.S. State Department and met with Walter Smith, the Deputy Under Secretary whom President Eisenhower had mentioned. According to accounts, they exchanged views on the impending armistice, the economic reconstruction of a Korea ravaged by war, and various matters of security. It was a remarkably fortuitous "convergence." An unplanned meeting with the U.S. President had taken place, and likewise, there had been an unplanned request from Paik Sun-yup for a "defense treaty." Finally, following Eisenhower's remark that he "agreed in principle," there was also the recommendation to meet with Smith. <<> As later became known, General Mark Clark, the Commander-in-Chief of the United Nations Command in Tokyo, reportedly received a cable from Washington around that time. It is said to have read: "From now on, place the matter of a mutual defense treaty with Korea on the table and negotiate it officially." It was a message that the discussions on the ROK-U.S. Mutual Defense Treaty, which until then had been conducted covertly or in top secrecy, could now proceed openly. At the time, the armistice negotiations with the communist side were in their final stages, and it is said that the United States had finally begun a serious review of the mutual defense treaty issue with Korea around that period. <<> In that regard, Paik Sun-yup's visit to Washington is notable in many ways. Even if his remarks were not decisive, Washington, which sought to finalize the armistice while formalizing the defense treaty discussions, could be seen as observing something through Paik Sun-yup, the most powerful figure in the South Korean military. <<> In that atmosphere, Paik Sun-yup completed his Washington schedule and headed to New York. First, he made an official visit to West Point. A familiar face was there. It was Michaelis, his old comrade-in-arms who, in the final stages of the "Battle of Dabudong" in August 1950, when the fate of the Republic of Korea hung in the balance, had arrived with tank units and overwhelming firepower, establishing defensive lines in the Cheonpyeong-dong valley and blocking North Korean forces on the axis of advance toward Daegu. <<> He had already been promoted to Brigadier General while serving as Commandant of Cadets at West Point. Paik Sun-yup recounted that Michaelis seemed somewhat awkward when Paik, who had been a Brigadier General during the Battle of Dabudong, appeared now with the rank of General on his shoulders. His face, handsome enough to rival a movie star, bore an expression of being moved while looking upon his proud comrade Paik Sun-yup. <<> Next, Paik Sun-yup met with the retired war hero Douglas MacArthur in New York. It was not a gathering to which MacArthur had invited him. Nor was it part of any pre-arranged official schedule. Paik Sun-yup, having simply heard that MacArthur was staying in New York, undertook a "courtesy call" on his own initiative. It is a moment that reveals Paik Sun-yup's character. <<> At the time, MacArthur did not hold Paik Sun-yup in his memory. However, he reportedly welcomed Paik Sun-yup, the Chief of Staff of the Republic of Korea Army, who had come to pay his respects to the man who had defended the Korean front lines. In the late 1950s, when Paik Sun-yup assumed the post of Chief of Staff for the second time, he again made a "courtesy call" on MacArthur, who was a few years from his passing, during a visit to the United States. He had not forgotten the grace of the man who had stood alongside him on the Korean front lines against the threat of communist subjugation. <<> Paik Sun-yup then visited the U.S. Army Infantry School at Fort Benning, Georgia, among other places. There were Korean military students there. They reportedly struggled because they had not properly mastered English. At the time, it is said that the "me too" of Korean officers studying in the U.S. was a big topic of conversation among the staff at the Infantry School. During meal times, they would line up in front of each assigned cook to receive their food, and the Korean officers, unskilled in English, would stand behind those who ordered first, and when their turn came, they would uniformly say "me too." <<> From today's perspective, it's a rather amusing anecdote, but through such trials and tribulations, the ROK military reportedly learned diligently. Overall academic performance of the Korean officers was said to have consistently been at a very high level. Next, Paik Sun-yup went to the Command and General Staff College at Fort Leavenworth, Kansas. <<> That place was the final stop on Paik Sun-yup's visit to the U.S. and, formally, the primary destination of his trip. At the Command and General Staff College, about 30 U.S. military instructors conducted an intensive, accelerated course centered on Paik Sun-yup alone. It was the highest level of education on command and staff operations for the supreme commander of the ROK military. Paik Sun-yup's training schedule had originally been set for two weeks. Due to the tightly packed schedule, he could not leisurely exchange pleasantries with the familiar colleagues who were already studying there. At that Command and General Staff College were his welcome comrades, Generals Lee Jong-chan, Chung Il-kwon, Choi Young-hee, Park Byung-kwon, and Chung Rae-hyuk. <<> Only a few days had passed, it is said. Paik Sun-yup remembered it as being less than ten days in. There was a sudden summons from President Syngman Rhee. The phone call from President Rhee, which came into the college's office, traveled across the Pacific with a calm yet somehow suggestive voice, he reportedly said. <<> President Rhee said, "Old friend, if things there aren't urgent, then just come on back." At that time, a strong cold current was flowing between Korea and the United States. Perhaps it was akin to the atmosphere just before a storm. Discussions on the ROK-U.S. Mutual Defense Treaty were on the verge of formally coming to the table, and President Syngman Rhee was expressing great dissatisfaction with the armistice that was rapidly progressing regardless of the Republic of Korea's will for unification. <<> If those signs of conflict had spread in earnest, it would have been a grave matter. It was fortunate that the summons for Paik Sun-yup was the only one. At the time, some U.S. media reported on the conflict between Korea and the U.S. administration, suggesting that "President Rhee could order the return of all Korean military officers studying in the United States." If that had happened, the conflict between the two countries would have escalated to its peak. But President Rhee only urged the return of one person: Paik Sun-yup, the Army Chief of Staff, who was visiting the United States. <<> Accordingly, Paik Sun-yup, without completing the full training schedule at the Command and General Staff College, reportedly hurriedly embarked on his journey home. It was a reversal of the route he had taken to visit the United States. He crossed the Pacific again and landed in Tokyo. From there, he had to board a military aircraft again to head to Seoul. In Tokyo, he met again with General Mark Clark, the Commander-in-Chief of the United Nations Command. Paik Sun-yup recalled that Clark said: "I convey the message from the U.S. administration that you may relay to President Syngman Rhee the contents of the conversations you have had so far regarding the mutual defense treaty." <<> Leaving Tokyo and arriving in Seoul, Paik Sun-yup went straight to Gyeongmudae to see President Syngman Rhee. However, the roads were completely blocked, it is said. The streets were filled with demonstrators. They were chanting, "Give us unification or death" and "We must drive out the Chinese communist forces from the north." That was the atmosphere in Seoul. The conflict with the United States, which sought to conclude the armistice, remained, and it was gradually growing into something enormous. <<> (이튿날 아침 백선엽은 미 국무부를 방문해 아이젠하워 미 대통령이 언급한 월터 스미스 차관보와 면담했다. 앞으로 닥칠 휴전, 전쟁으로 피폐해진 대한민국의 경제적 재건, 안보에 관한 여러 의견을 나눴다고 한다. 매우 공교로운 ‘집합’이었다. 예정에 없던 미 대통령과의 면담이 이뤄졌고, 역시 예정에 없던 백선엽의 ‘방위 조약’ 요청이 있었다. 마침내 “원칙적으로 동의한다”는 아이젠하워 언급에 이어 스미스를 만나보라는 권유도 있었다.)

item.title: North Korea claims ROK-US UFS drills "cause security instability," announces exercise of "right to self-defense" (北, 한미 UFS 훈련에 “안보 불안정 유발” 주장… “정당방위권 행사” 예고)
item.description:
North Korea claims ROK-US UFS drills "cause security instability," announces exercise of "right to self-defense" (北, 한미 UFS 훈련에 “안보 불안정 유발” 주장… “정당방위권 행사” 예고)

North Korea on the 14th condemned the ROK-US combined exercise "Ulchi Freedom Shield" (UFS) for "causing a level of security instability different from previous years," while announcing the exercise of its so-called "right to self-defense." (북한이 14일 한미 연합 훈련 ‘을지 자유의 방패’(UFS)에 대해 “예년과 다른 수준의 안보 불안정 상황을 유발하고 있다”고 비난하면서 이른바 ‘정당방위권’ 행사를 예고했다.)

In a statement by a spokesperson of the Foreign Ministry published through the Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) on the same day, North Korea said, "This exercise mobilizes tens of thousands of troops and combat technical equipment, including the armed forces of the United States, South Korea, and member states of the 'United Nations Command,' and during the exercise period, outdoor maneuver drills including 'Warrior Shield,' as well as various live-fire drills simulating advanced operational environments such as drone warfare, electronic warfare, and cyber warfare, are scheduled to be carried out." (북한은 이날 조선중앙통신을 통해 발표한 외무성 대변인 담화에서 “이번 연습에는 미국과 한국, ‘유엔군사령부’ 성원국들의 무력을 포함한 수만 명의 병력과 전투 기술 기재들이 동원되며, 연습 기간 ‘워리어 실드’를 비롯한 야외 기동 훈련과 무인기전, 전자전, 사이버전과 같은 첨단 작전 환경을 가상한 각종 실전 훈련들이 강행될 예정”이라고 했다.)

UFS is an annual computer-simulation-based command post exercise conducted by the ROK and the US, scheduled to take place from the 17th to the 27th. Fourteen outdoor maneuver drills at the battalion-level or above, linked to the exercise, will also be conducted. (UFS는 한미가 연례적으로 하는 컴퓨터 시뮬레이션 기반 지휘소 연습으로, 오는 17~27일 시행된다. 이와 연계된 대대급 이상 단위의 야외 기동 훈련도 14건 실시된다.)

North Korea claimed, "The United States has made clear that this joint military exercise is distinctly different from the drills of the past five years, and that the focus of the exercise has been placed on mastering war-fighting capabilities based on new aspects of modern warfare, thereby not hiding the fact that its purpose lies in completing preparations for an actual military confrontation with our state." (북한은 “미국은 이번 합동 군사 연습이 지난 5년간의 연습들과는 명백히 다르며, 연습의 초점을 현대전의 새로운 양상에 입각한 전쟁 수행 능력 숙달에 두었다는 것을 공개함으로써, 그 목적이 우리 국가와의 실제적인 군사적 대결 준비 완성에 있다는 것을 숨기지 않았다”고 주장했다.)

It further claimed, "This amounts to an admission that this exercise, which the US and South Korea argue is 'annual' and 'defensive,' is in essence a demonstration of aggressive war." (이어 “이것은 미·한이 이른바 ‘연례적’, ‘방어적’이라고 강변하는 이번 연습이 본질상 침략 전쟁 시연이라는 것을 자인한 것이 된다”고 주장했다.)

North Korea said, "At this point when the military and political situation in the international arena is growing increasingly grave and the US abuse of power is becoming routine, the large-scale war exercise by the US and South Korea once again is causing a level of security instability different from previous years on the Korean Peninsula and in the region beyond." (북한은 “국제적 판도에서 군사 정치 정세가 날로 엄중해지고 미국의 힘의 남용이 일상화되고 있는 현 시점에 또다시 벌어지는 미·한의 대규모 전쟁 연습은 조선반도(한반도)와 그 너머의 지역에서 예년과 다른 수준의 안보 불안정 상황을 유발하고 있다”고 했다.)

North Korea particularly noted, "The aggressive posture adjustments of US armed forces being pursued in earnest on a global scale, and as part of that, the deepening strategic flexibility of US Forces Korea, the trilateral military cooperation framework of the US, Japan, and South Korea, which is morphing into a nuclear alliance, and the military buildups of Japan and South Korea, are further highlighting the danger of the UFS joint military exercise, in which all military assets and war-fighting methods held by the US and South Korea are mobilized." (북한은 특히 “전 지구적 범위에서 본격화되고 있는 미군 무력의 공격적인 태세 조정과 그 일환으로 심화되는 주한 미군의 전략적 유연성 확대, 핵 동맹으로 변이되고 있는 미·일·한 3각 군사 공조 체제와 일본과 한국의 군사력 확충은 미·한이 보유한 군사 자산들과 전쟁 수행 방식이 총동원되는 UFS 합동 군사 연습의 위험성을 보다 부각시키고 있다”고 했다.)

North Korea claimed, "Serious threats are being created to our state's security domain and the region's security environment by the aggressive war exercises of hostile states." (북한은 “적수국들의 침략 전쟁 연습으로 우리 국가의 안전 영역과 지역의 안보 환경에는 엄중한 위협이 조성되고 있다”고 주장했다.)

It added, "Applying a new level of deterrence to a new level of threat is our consistent principle of security assurance," and "The will of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea to frustrate all hostile acts from outside with the strongest and most overwhelming response capability and to absolutely defend the supreme interests of state security is firm and unwavering." (그러면서 “새로운 수준의 위협에 새로운 수준의 억제력을 적용하는 것은 우리의 일관한 안전 보장 원칙”이라며 “가장 강력하고 압도적인 대응력으로 외부로부터의 온갖 적대 행위를 좌절시키고 국가 안전의 최고 이익을 절대적으로 수호하려는 조선민주주의인민공화국의 의지는 확고부동하다”고 했다.)

North Korea said, "The serious state of force confrontation created by hostile states will not be tolerated in the slightest, and through the responsible and resolute exercise of the right to self-defense, our stance toward the enemy, which seeks to thoroughly disallow any arbitrary threats and challenges, will be expressed more clearly." (북한은 “적수국들이 조성하는 엄중한 힘의 대치 국면은 추호도 용납되지 않을 것이며, 책임적이고도 단호한 정당방위권 행사로, 임의의 위협과 도전도 철저히 불허하려는 우리의 대적 입장은 보다 명백히 표현될 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok vs. Jeong Cheong-rae in tight race — 'public opinion poll' emerges as variable (김민석·정청래 박빙 싸움 변수 ‘국민 여론조사’ 시작)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok vs. Jeong Cheong-rae in tight race — 'public opinion poll' emerges as variable (김민석·정청래 박빙 싸움 변수 ‘국민 여론조사’ 시작)

As the August 17 National Convention regional primaries to elect the next leadership of the Democratic Party of Korea show a neck-and-neck race between party leader candidates Kim Min-seok and Jeong Cheong-rae, the public opinion poll that has emerged as a key variable in determining the final outcome begins on the 14th. With the vote gap between candidates Kim and Jeong at just 1.45 percentage points, the public opinion poll accounts for 30% of the final result. (더불어민주당 차기 지도부를 뽑는 8·17 전당대회 순회 경선이 김민석·정청래 당대표 후보 간 박빙 싸움 양상을 보이면서 최종 결과를 가를 변수로 떠오른 국민 여론조사가 14일 시작된다. 김·정 후보의 득표율 차가 1.45%포인트에 그친 가운데, 국민 여론조사는 최종 결과의 30%를 차지한다.)

The Democratic Party will conduct the poll over two days from today through the 15th. The method involves calling random wireless phone numbers beginning with 010 (RDD) to request responses to the survey. To prevent so-called 'reverse selection,' only responses from those who said they support the Democratic Party or who said they have no supporting party will be reflected in the survey results. The party plans to collect more than 2,000 such responses. Responses from those who said they support other parties, such as the People Power Party, the Reform Party, or the Fatherland Innovation Party, will not be reflected. (민주당은 이날부터 15일까지 이틀간 여론조사를 시행한다. 010으로 시작하는 임의의 무선 전화번호에 전화를 걸어(RDD) 여론조사 응답을 청하는 방식이다. 이른바 ‘역선택’ 방지를 위해, 지지 정당이 민주당이라고 답한 사람과 지지 정당이 없다고 답한 사람의 응답만 조사 결과에 반영한다. 이런 응답을 2000개 이상 받을 예정이다. 국민의힘, 개혁신당, 조국혁신당 등 다른 정당을 지지한다고 답한 사람의 응답은 반영되지 않는다.)

In the party member voting results disclosed so far, candidate Kim has received 96,799.25 votes (46.00%), leading candidate Jeong, who has received 93,743.35 votes (44.55%), by 3,055.9 votes and 1.45 percentage points. Candidate Song Young-gil has received 19,902.6 votes (9.46%). This reflects the Democratic Party's decision to add a 5% bonus to votes from Daegu, North Gyeongsang, and South Gyeongsang, which the party designated as strategic regions. (지금까지 공개된 권리당원 투표에서는 김 후보가 9만6799.25표(46.00%)를 얻어, 9만3743.35표(44.55%)를 얻은 정 후보를 3055.9표, 1.45%포인트 차로 앞서고 있다. 송영길 후보는 1만9902.6표(9.46%)를 얻었다. 민주당이 전략 지역으로 정한 대구·경북·경남 득표 수에 5%를 가산하기로 한 것을 반영한 결과다.)

Public opinion poll results released so far have been mixed. In a survey conducted by Realmeter on the 9th–10th among 1,053 Democratic Party supporters and independents, candidate Kim led with 46.8% versus candidate Jeong's 35.2%, a gap of 11.6 percentage points, beyond the margin of error (±3.0 percentage points). In contrast, a survey commissioned by Newsis from Ace Research over the same period among 646 Democratic Party supporters and independents showed a tight race, with candidate Kim at 36.9% and candidate Jeong at 36.7%, a difference of just 0.2 percentage points. (지금까지 발표된 여론조사 결과는 엇갈리고 있다. 리얼미터가 지난 9~10일 민주당 지지층과 무당층 1053명을 대상으로 시행한 조사에서는 김 후보 46.8%, 정 후보 35.2%로 김 후보가 오차 범위(±3.0%포인트) 밖인 11.6%포인트 차로 앞섰다. 반면 뉴시스가 에이스리서치에 의뢰해 같은 기간 민주당 지지층과 무당층 646명을 대상으로 한 조사에서는 김 후보 36.9%, 정 후보 36.7%로 0.2%포인트 차 접전이었다.)

In a survey conducted by Embrain Public, K-Stat Research, Korea Research, and Hankook Research on the 10th–12th, candidate Kim led significantly among 404 Democratic Party supporters with 44% versus candidate Jeong's 25%, but among 295 independents the gap was negligible, with candidate Kim at 9% and candidate Jeong at 8%. (엠브레인퍼블릭·케이스탯리서치·코리아리서치·한국리서치가 지난 10~12일 시행한 조사에서는 민주당 지지층 404명 사이에서는 김 후보가 44%, 정 후보가 25%로 김 후보가 크게 앞섰으나, 무당층 295명 사이에서는 김 후보 9%, 정 후보 8%로 차이가 거의 없었다.)

The Democratic Party will combine the regional primary results disclosed so far, the Honam primary results to be released on the 15th, the Seoul and Gyeonggi primary results to be released on the 16th, along with the national convention delegate voting results and the public opinion poll results, to announce the winner on the 17th. (민주당은 지금까지 공개된 순회 경선 결과와 15일 공개되는 호남 경선 결과, 16일 공개되는 서울·경기 경선 결과에 전국대의원 투표 결과와 국민 여론조사 결과 등을 합산해 17일 당선자를 발표한다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok: "Abolishing Long-Term Holding Special Deduction for Non-Resident Single-Home Owners Is a Tax Increase"... Effectively Opposes Government Tax Reform Proposal (김민석 “비거주 1주택자 장특공제 폐지는 증세”… 정부 세제 개편안 사실상 반대)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok: "Abolishing Long-Term Holding Special Deduction for Non-Resident Single-Home Owners Is a Tax Increase"... Effectively Opposes Government Tax Reform Proposal (김민석 “비거주 1주택자 장특공제 폐지는 증세”… 정부 세제 개편안 사실상 반대)

Kim Min-seok, a candidate for the leadership of the Democratic Party of Korea, said on the 14th regarding the real estate tax reform proposal announced by the government on the 3rd, "We will revise and supplement the details." While Kim stated that he "sympathizes with the overall direction of the tax reform proposal," he effectively signaled opposition to key provisions, including tax increases on capital gains tax and comprehensive real estate tax for non-resident single-home owners. (김민석 더불어민주당 당대표 후보가 정부가 지난 3일 발표한 부동산 세제 개편안에 대해 14일 “디테일(세부 사항)을 수정·보완해가겠다”고 했다. 김 후보는 “세제 개편안의 큰 방향에 공감한다”고 했지만, 비거주 1주택자에 대한 양도소득세·종합부동산세 증세 등 핵심 내용에 사실상 반대한다는 뜻을 밝혔다.)

In a post on social media platform X (formerly Twitter) that morning, Kim wrote, "Regarding the recently announced real estate tax reform proposal, I believe discussions on supplementing the details are necessary on the premise that we sympathize with the overall direction." (김 후보는 이날 오전 소셜미디어 X(옛 트위터)에 글을 올려 “최근 발표된 부동산 세제 개편안은 큰 방향에 공감하는 전제 위에서 디테일 보완 논의가 필요하다고 본다”고 했다.)

Kim noted, "Because there are a significant number of non-resident middle-class single-home owners nationwide, we must pay particular attention to how tax changes affecting them could trigger ripple effects on the jeonse (key money deposit) and monthly rental markets." (김 후보는 “중산층 1주택 비거주자가 전국적으로 상당수 되기 때문에, 이들에 대한 세금 변화가 전·월세 시장까지 연쇄 반응을 미치는 부분을 특히 유념해야 한다”고 짚었다.)

He added, "Regarding the capital gains tax, abolishing the holding deduction for non-resident single-home owners amounts to a de facto tax increase for non-resident owners of single homes valued at 1.2 billion won or more, which covers most apartments in Seoul, and concerns have been raised that it could lead to side effects such as forcing tenants to vacate." (그러면서 “양도세에 있어 1주택 비거주자의 보유 공제를 폐지하는 것은, 서울의 웬만한 아파트에 해당되는 시가 12억원 이상 1주택 비거주자들에게는 사실상 증세인 면도 있고, 임차인 퇴거 강요 등의 부작용을 초래할 수 있다는 우려가 제기되고 있다”고 했다.)

The government had proposed in its tax reform plan to abolish the "Long-Term Holding Special Deduction" for capital gains tax by 2029 and replace it with a "Long-Term Residency Income Deduction" based only on actual residency periods—a move Kim has now come out against. (정부는 세제 개편안에서 양도세 ‘장기 보유 특별 공제’(장특공제)를 2029년 폐지하고 실제 거주 기간만 따져서 공제해주는 ‘장기 거주 소득 공제’로 바꾸겠다고 했는데, 김 후보가 이에 반대하고 나선 것이다.)

Kim also said, "Regarding the comprehensive real estate tax, even if the current system is maintained as is, the tax burden on non-residents will naturally increase due to rising official property prices, so wouldn't it be sufficient to simply raise the basic deduction for actual residents to 1.4 billion won?" (김 후보는 또 “종부세는 현행 제도를 그대로 유지해도 공시 가격 상승으로 비거주자의 세 부담이 자연 증가하므로, 실거주자의 기본 공제를 14억원(으로) 상향(하는 것으로)만 개선해도 어떨까 한다”고 했다.)

The government's tax reform proposal stated that the comprehensive real estate tax would be levied on homes with official prices of at least 1.4 billion won, rather than 1.2 billion won, while reducing the deduction for non-resident single-home owners from 1.2 billion won to 900 million won. Kim opposes this as well, arguing that the deduction for non-resident single-home owners should remain unchanged while retaining benefits only for actual resident single-home owners. (정부는 세제 개편안에서 종부세는 공시 가격 12억원 이상이 아니라 14억원 이상 주택부터 과세하되, 비거주 1주택자의 공제액은 12억원에서 9억원으로 줄이겠다고 했다. 김 후보는 이에 대해서도 반대하고, 비거주 1주택자에 대한 공제는 현행대로 두고 실거주 1주택자에 대한 혜택만 남겨두자고 한 것이다.)

Although Kim did not mention it directly, he also appears to oppose the abolition of the holding period deduction for the comprehensive real estate tax for non-resident single-home owners and the introduction of a deduction cap (6 million won per year). (김 후보는 직접 언급하지는 않았지만 비거주 1주택자에 대한 종부세 보유 기간 공제 폐지, 공제 한도(연 600만원) 설정도 반대한 것으로 보인다.)

Kim continued, "It is also undesirable for joint spousal ownership to be treated differently from sole ownership, regardless of whether the owner is an actual resident or not." The tax reform plan includes a provision that treats couples who jointly own a single home but do not reside in it the same as multiple-home owners for comprehensive real estate tax purposes—a point Kim says should also be corrected. (김 후보는 이어 “실거주이든 비거주이든 부부 공동 명의가 단독 명의에 비해 차별화되는 것도 바람직하지 않다”고 했다. 세제 개편안은 부부가 1주택을 공동 소유하면서 해당 주택에 거주하지 않고 있을 경우, 종부세 과세 시 다주택자와 똑같이 취급하는 부분이 있는데, 김 후보가 이 부분도 고쳐야 한다고 한 것이다.)

Kim said, "There also appears to be room for debate regarding the incentive for those aged 65 and over relocating to provincial areas," proposing that seniors who sell homes in the capital region and move to provincial areas should receive benefits. (김 후보는 “65세 이상 지방 이주 인센티브에 대해서도 토론 여지가 있다고 보인다”며, 고령자가 수도권 주택을 팔고 지방으로 이주할 경우 혜택을 주자는 제안도 했다.)

Kim stated, "The party convention will be over soon, so as the President has said, the party will thoroughly gather input from the public, experts, and the opposition, and revise and supplement the details through party-government consultations." (김 후보는 “곧 전당대회를 마치니, 대통령께서 말씀하신 대로 당이 국민, 전문가, 야당의 의견을 잘 수렴해 당정 협의를 통해 디테일을 수정·보완해가겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: Chung Cheong-rae: "If the Indictment of President Lee Is Fabricated, It Should Naturally Be Withdrawn... Re-election Constitutional Amendment Is Impossible" (정청래 “李대통령 기소, 조작이라면 당연 취소해야… 연임 개헌은 불가능”)
item.description:
Chung Cheong-rae: "If the Indictment of President Lee Is Fabricated, It Should Naturally Be Withdrawn... Re-election Constitutional Amendment Is Impossible" (정청래 “李대통령 기소, 조작이라면 당연 취소해야… 연임 개헌은 불가능”)

Chung Cheong-rae, a candidate for the leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, said on the 14th regarding the withdrawal of the indictment against President Lee Jae-myung, "If the indictment was made through fabrication, it must naturally be withdrawn," adding, "Rep. Kim Min-seok's remarks are correct in principle." (정청래 더불어민주당 당대표 후보는 14일 이재명 대통령 사건 공소(기소) 취소와 관련해 “(검찰이) 조작을 해서 기소가 됐다면 그것은 당연히 취소돼야 한다”며 “김민석 의원 말이 원칙적으로 맞다”고 했다.)

Appearing that morning on BBS Radio's "Jung Hye-seung's Morning Journal," the candidate was asked by the host to evaluate Rep. Kim Min-seok's statement that "if a fabricated indictment is clearly established, withdrawal of the indictment is the principle" and Rep. Song Young-gil's remark that "we should pursue a special counsel for the fabricated indictment, but the special counsel should not be given the authority to withdraw the indictment." He responded as above. (정 후보는 이날 오전 BBS라디오 ‘정혜승의 아침저널’에 출연해 진행자에게서 “조작 기소가 명확하면 공소 취소가 원칙”이라는 김민석 후보 말과 “조작 기소 특검을 추진하되 특검의 공소 취소 권한은 빼야 한다”는 송영길 후보 말에 대한 평가를 요청받고 이같이 답했다.)

However, Chung added, "There are differing views on what constitutes confirmation (of a fabricated indictment)," noting, "There are competing arguments—one that 'if a fabricated indictment is confirmed at the prosecution's indictment stage, it should be withdrawn,' and another that 'the fabricated indictment must be confirmed through a final Supreme Court ruling, and only then can the indictment be withdrawn.'" (정 후보는 다만 “어떤 것이 (조작 기소됐다는) 확인이냐에 대해서는 양론이 있다”며 “‘검찰 기소 단계에서 (조작 기소가) 확인됐다면 취소해야 한다’(는 주장과) ‘대법원 확정 판결로 조작 기소가 확정돼야 그때 가서 공소를 취소할 수 있다’(는 주장 등) 양론이 존재한다”고 했다.)

Regarding National Assembly Speaker Cho Jung-sik's late last month remarks about a constitutional amendment allowing a sitting president to seek re-election—which sparked controversy when he said it was "ultimately a matter of public opinion and choice by the sovereign people"—Chung said, "Speaker Cho's remarks have been characterized as misleading, and (a re-election amendment) is impossible under Article 128 of the Constitution." (정 후보는 조정식 국회의장이 지난달 말 현직 대통령의 연임을 가능하게 하는 개헌에 관해 “결국 주권자인 국민의 여론과 선택의 문제”라고 말해 논란을 빚은 데 대해서는 “조 의장이 오해의 소지가 있게 발언한 것으로 정리됐고, (연임 개헌은) 헌법 128조상 불가능하다”고 했다.)

He added, "We should just end it there as impossible. If we keep talking about it, it will seem like there's something to it, but there isn't." (그러면서 “그냥 (불가능한 것으로) 딱 끝내야지, 더 이야기하면 자꾸 이것이 뭐가 있는 것처럼 되는데, 뭐가 없다”고 했다.)

When asked whether a constitutional amendment is necessary—at least to enshrine the spirit of the May 18 Democratization Movement in the Constitution—and whether cooperation with the People Power Party is needed to achieve it, Chung dismissed the idea, saying, "Cooperating with the people is more important than cooperating with the People Power Party." (정 후보는 ‘5·18 정신’을 헌법에 명기하기 위해서라도 개헌이 필요하고, 개헌을 위해서는 국민의힘과 협치해야 하지 않느냐는 지적에 “국민의힘하고 손잡는 것보다 국민하고 손잡는 게 더 중요하다”고 일축했다.)

Chung also addressed being categorized as anti-Lee (anti-Lee Jae-myung), calling it "a media frame" and claiming that "(candidates like Kim Min-seok and Song Young-gil) are attacking by riding on that fictitious frame." (정 후보는 또 자신이 반명(반이재명)으로 분류되는 데 대해 “언론의 프레임”이라며 “(김민석·송영길 후보 등이) 그 허구적인 프레임에 편승해서 공격하는 것”이라고 주장했다.)

On the current landscape of the party convention, he retorted, "If you analyze and predict, does it always turn out as predicted?" He then said, "It's a heavily tilted playing field," adding, "Right now (the other candidates) are beating me at nearly two-to-one, three-to-one, four-to-one, five-to-one, and almost all media and broadcast panelists are attacking me too." (전당대회 현재 판세에 대해서는 “분석하고 예상하면 예상대로 되느냐”고 반문했다. 이어 “많이 기울어진 운동장”이라며 “지금 (후보들이) 저를 거의 2대1, 3대1, 4대1, 5대1로 저를 두들겨 패고 있고, 거의 모든 언론과 방송 패널이 두들겨 패고 있다”고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee's Approval Rating 44%...Drops 7 Percentage Points, Lowest Since Taking Office [Gallup Korea] (李대통령 지지율 44%...7%p 하락, 취임 후 최저 [한국갤럽])
item.description:
President Lee's Approval Rating 44%...Drops 7 Percentage Points, Lowest Since Taking Office [Gallup Korea] (李대통령 지지율 44%...7%p 하락, 취임 후 최저 [한국갤럽])

A poll result showed that President Lee Jae-myung's approval rating for his administration has hit its lowest point since taking office. (이재명 대통령의 국정 수행 지지도가 취임 후 최저치를 기록했다는 여론조사 결과가 나왔다.)

In a survey conducted by Gallup Korea from the 11th to the 13th with 1,000 eligible voters aged 18 and older nationwide, 44% of respondents said he is "doing well" and 46% said he is "doing poorly." The positive approval rating fell by 7 percentage points (p) compared to the previous survey, while the negative rating rose by 8 percentage points. This is the first time in Gallup Korea's polls that the negative rating has surpassed the positive rating. (한국갤럽이 11~13일 전국 만 18세 이상 유권자 1000명에게 조사한 대통령 직무 수행 평가에서 ‘잘 하고 있다’는 응답은 44%, ‘못 하고 있다’는 응답은 46%로 조사됐다. 긍정 응답률은 직전 조사 대비 7%포인트(p) 하락한 반면, 부정 응답률은 8%p 상승했다. 한국갤럽 조사에서 부정률 수치가 긍정률을 넘어선 것은 이번이 처음이다.)

The top reasons cited for positive evaluations were diplomacy (19%), economy and livelihood (15%), and doing well overall (8%). For negative evaluations, real estate policy (30%) was the overwhelming top reason, followed by economy and livelihood, and doing poorly overall (7%). By age group, positive ratings were highest among those in their 40s (58%) and 50s (56%), and lowest among those in their 20s (30%) and those aged 70 or older (35%). (긍정 평가 이유로는 외교(19%), 경제·민생(15%), 전반적으로 잘한다(8%) 순이었다. 부정 평가 이유로는 부동산 정책(30%)이 압도적 1위였고, 이어 경제·민생, 전반적으로 잘못한다(7%) 순이었다. 연령별 직무 긍정률은 40대(58%)와 50대(56%)에서 높았고, 20대(30%)와 70대 이상(35%)에서 낮았다.)

When asked about the impact of the government's real estate tax reform proposal on the housing market, 45% said it would have a negative impact, while only 24% said it would have a positive impact. (정부의 부동산 세제 개편안이 주택 시장에 미칠 영향을 묻는 질문엔 45%가 부정적 영향을 줄 것이라고 답했고, 긍정적 영향이라는 응답은 24%에 그쳤다.)

Meanwhile, in the party support survey, the Democratic Party of Korea stood at 41% and the People Power Party at 25%. The Democratic Party dropped by 3 percentage points from the previous week, while the People Power Party rose by 2 percentage points. They were followed by the Reform Party at 3%, the Fatherland Innovation Party at 2%, and the Progressive Party at 1%. (한편 지지 정당 조사는 더불어민주당 41%, 국민의힘 25%였다. 민주당은 전주 대비 3%p 하락한 반면 국민의힘은 2%p 상승했다. 이어 개혁신당 3%, 조국혁신당 2%, 진보당 1% 순이었다.)

On the amendment to the Criminal Procedure Act that fully abolishes prosecutors' supplementary investigation powers, only 27% evaluated it as a "good thing," while 50% evaluated it as a "bad thing." (검사의 보완수사권을 전면 폐지하는 형사소송법 개정안에 대해서도 ‘잘된 일’이라는 평가는 27%에 그친 반면, ‘잘못된 일’이란 평가는 50%였다.)

This survey was conducted using the RDD method via telephone interviews (ARS). The response rate was 9.7%, and the margin of error was ±3.1 percentage points at a 95% confidence level. For more details, refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission website. (이번 조사는 RDD 방식을 이용한 전화면접조사(ARS)로 진행됐다. 응답률은 9.7%, 표본 오차는 95% 신뢰 수준에서 ±3.1%p였다. 자세한 내용은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 홈페이지 참조.)

item.title: Lawmaker Lee Un-ju Criticizes Government EV Subsidies: "Should Go to Producers, Not Buyers... Otherwise China Will Take It All" (與 이언주, 정부 전기차 보조금 비판 “구매자 아닌 생산자에 줘야… 아니면 중국에 다 빼앗겨”)
item.description:
Lawmaker Lee Un-ju Criticizes Government EV Subsidies: "Should Go to Producers, Not Buyers... Otherwise China Will Take It All" (與 이언주, 정부 전기차 보조금 비판 “구매자 아닌 생산자에 줘야… 아니면 중국에 다 빼앗겨”)

Democratic Party lawmaker Lee Un-ju criticized the government's electric vehicle subsidy policy. (더불어민주당 이언주 의원이 정부의 전기차 보조금 정책을 비판했다.)

On the morning of the 14th, the lawmaker shared on Facebook an article reporting that Chinese-made vehicles' share of the domestic EV market has risen to 35.0%, yet the government's tax reform proposal announced on the 3rd excluded domestic production from tax credit eligibility. (이 의원은 14일 오전 페이스북에 국내 전기차 시장에서 중국산의 점유율이 35.0%로 높아졌으나, 정부가 지난 3일 발표한 세제 개편안에서는 국내 생산 세액 공제 대상에서 빠졌다는 내용의 기사를 공유했다.)

In response, Lee said, "I've been raising similar concerns repeatedly for years, but little has changed." She added, "China has been providing 'producer subsidies' paid directly to manufacturers. In contrast, South Korea, for environmental protection, has been giving 'consumer subsidies' through the Ministry of Climate and Energy to promote the adoption of eco-friendly vehicles, whether Chinese or Korean. We've been using taxpayers' money to subsidize buyers of imported cars, including Chinese ones, leaving EVs made by our workers on our soil at a competitive disadvantage." She further argued, "As a result, Chinese cars benefit from producer subsidies at home and consumer subsidies in Korea—double benefits—while Korean cars face reverse discrimination." (이 의원은 이와 관련해 “몇 년째 반복해서 유사한 문제 제기를 해 왔는데도 좀처럼 바뀌지 않는다”고 했다. 그는 “중국은 보조금을 생산자에게 지급하는 ‘생산자 보조금’을 지급해 왔는데, 우리나라는 환경 보호를 위해 그간 기후에너지환경부가 그게 중국차든 한국차든 친환경 자동차 보급 차원에서 ‘구매자 보조금’을 줬다”며 “중국차 등 수입차에도 우린 국민 혈세로 구매자 보조금을 계속 줘서, 우리 땅에서 우리 노동자가 만든 전기차가 결과적으로 경쟁에서 밀리는 상황이 됐다”고 했다. 그러면서 “결과적으로 중국차는 자국에서 생산자 보조금도 받고, 한국에서 구매자 보조금도 받고, 이중 혜택을 받는 바람에 한국차는 역차별을 받게 된 셈”이라고 했다.)

Lee asserted, "In the modern world, the most important independence is technological independence and securing technological sovereignty. The only reason we're still holding on is that, amid the U.S.-China hegemonic rivalry, Korea has positioned itself as a strategic alternative to Chinese manufacturing, buying us time." (이 의원은 “현대 사회에서 가장 중요한 독립은 기술 독립이고 기술 주권의 확보”라며 “그나마 우리가 지금 이 정도라도 버티는 것은 미·중 패권 경쟁 틈바구니에서 한국이 중국 제조의 전략적 대안으로 포지셔닝되어 시간을 벌었기 때문”이라고 주장했다.)

She continued, "But we don't know how much of that time remains. Ahead of tomorrow's Liberation Day, I want to stress once again: above environmental ideals or humanitarian principles, the priority must be national interest, sovereignty, and the survival of our own industries and citizens." (이 의원은 이어 “그러나 그 시간마저 얼마나 남았는지는 모르겠다”며 “내일 광복절을 앞두고 다시 한번 강조한다. 환경, 인도주의, 이런 이상보다도 우선하는 가치는 바로 국익과 주권, 자국 산업과 자국민의 생존”이라고 했다.)

She said, "Isn't it enough to regret after losing everything, as we did in the past due to such foolishness? The tax reform proposal omits tax credits for Korean-made EVs, so I will submit a revision bill." (그는 “다 빼앗기고 나서 후회하는 건 과거의 어리석음으로 족하지 않은가”라며 “한국산 전기차 생산 세액 공제에 관한 내용이 세제 개편안에 빠져 있는데, 개정안을 제출하겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: Kazakhstan Workers to Arrive Starting 2028… Employment Permit System Sending Countries Expand to 18 (2028년부터 카자흐스탄 근로자 들어온다… 고용 허가제 송출국 18국으로 확대)
item.description:
Kazakhstan Workers to Arrive Starting 2028… Employment Permit System Sending Countries Expand to 18 (2028년부터 카자흐스탄 근로자 들어온다… 고용 허가제 송출국 18국으로 확대)

The government has added Kazakhstan to the list of countries allowed to send low-skilled workers to South Korea as of the 14th. (정부가 한국에 저숙련 근로자를 보낼 수 있는 국가로 14일 카자흐스탄을 추가 지정했다.)

The Office for Government Policy Coordination announced that it held the 49th Foreign Workforce Policy Committee meeting that morning at the Government Complex Seoul and the Government Complex Sejong, chaired by the Deputy Prime Minister for Economic Affairs and Minister of the Office for Government Policy Coordination, Im Ki-geun, where it confirmed the agenda item designating Kazakhstan as a sending country under the Employment Permit System (EPS). (국무총리실은 이날 오전 정부서울청사와 세종청사에서 임기근 국무조정실장 주재로 49차 외국인력정책위원회를 열어, 카자흐스탄을 고용 허가제 송출국으로 지정하는 안건을 확정했다고 밝혔다.)

Under the EPS, the government accepts low-skilled workers only from countries designated as labor-sending nations. Foreigners entering through this system are granted "non-professional employment" (E-9) visas and may only work in designated sectors, including manufacturing, construction, agriculture and livestock, fisheries, and construction waste processing. Their permitted stay in the country is limited to 4 years and 10 months. (정부는 고용 허가제를 통해, 인력 송출국으로 지정한 국가에서만 제한적으로 저숙련 근로자를 받아들이고 있다. 이를 통해 들어오는 외국인에게는 ‘비전문 취업’(E-9) 비자가 부여되고, 이들은 제조업, 건설업, 농축산업, 어업, 건설 폐기물 처리업 등 지정된 업종에만 취업할 수 있다. 국내 체류 기간은 4년 10개월로 제한된다.)

The sending countries previously numbered 17—China, Uzbekistan, Tajikistan, Kyrgyzstan, Mongolia, Indonesia, the Philippines, Vietnam, Thailand, Myanmar, Cambodia, Laos, Timor-Leste, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Nepal, and Sri Lanka—but with the addition of Kazakhstan, this has increased to 18. The population of the existing 17 countries is approximately 2.6 billion, while Kazakhstan has about 21 million people. (송출국은 중국, 우즈베키스탄, 타지키스탄, 키르기스스탄, 몽골, 인도네시아, 필리핀, 베트남, 태국, 미얀마, 캄보디아, 라오스, 동티모르, 파키스탄, 방글라데시, 네팔, 스리랑카 등 17국이었으나, 카자흐스탄 추가 지정으로 18국으로 늘었다. 기존 17국의 인구는 약 26억명, 카자흐스탄은 약 2100만명이다.)

Regarding the designation of additional sending countries, the government explained that it aims to "diversify sending countries, respond more effectively to on-site demand for labor introduction, and further solidify bilateral cooperation." (정부는 송출국 추가 지정에 대해 “송출국을 다변화하고 현장의 인력 도입 수요에 보다 효과적으로 대응하며, 양국 간 협력 관계를 더욱 공고히 하기 위한 것”이라고 설명했다.)

On the designation of Kazakhstan, it stated, "Kazakhstan has government and public institutions dedicated to handling labor dispatch, making it possible to ensure the public nature and transparency of the dispatch process. It was assessed that there are no particular issues in securing key infrastructure such as pre-employment training facilities, Employment Permit System centers, and health examination facilities for worker selection." It added, "We also confirmed Kazakhstan's willingness to cooperate, including institutional improvements to prevent illegal stay." (카자흐스탄을 지정한 것에 대해서는 “송출 업무를 전담할 수 있는 정부·공공기관을 두고 있어 송출 과정의 공공성과 투명성 확보가 가능하며, 인력 선발을 위한 사전 취업 교육 시설, 고용 허가제 센터, 건강 검진 시설 등 주요 인프라 확보에도 특별한 문제점이 없는 것으로 평가됐다”고 했다. “불법 체류 방지를 위한 제도 개선 등 카자흐스탄의 협력 의지도 확인했다”고 했다.)

Kazakhstan workers are expected to begin arriving in earnest starting 2028. The government said, "To ensure no disruptions in labor introduction, we will continue cooperation with Kazakhstan to sign a government-to-government MOU on the EPS and establish a local Employment Permit System center." (카자흐스탄 근로자들은 2028년부터 본격적으로 들어올 예정이다. 정부는 “인력 도입에 차질이 없도록, 정부 간 고용 허가제 MOU(양해 각서) 체결, 현지 고용 허가제 센터 설치 등을 위해 카자흐스탄과 협력을 지속해 나갈 것”이라고 했다.)

The government also announced partial changes to the operation of the Employment Permit System for foreign workers in the construction sector. (정부는 건설업 분야의 외국인 근로자 고용 허가제 운영 방식도 일부 변경했다고 밝혔다.)

Previously, employment permits and employment restriction measures were implemented on a per-construction-site basis, meaning reassigning foreign workers to different construction sites was only possible in limited cases, such as when work at the original site had been completed or halted. Additionally, employment restriction measures imposed when an employer violated labor laws applied only to the site where the violation occurred and did not extend to the employer's other sites, leading to criticism that they had little effect. (기존에는 건설 현장 단위로 고용 허가와 고용 제한 조치가 이뤄져, 외국인 근로자를 다른 건설 현장에 재배치하는 것은 기존 현장 공사가 종료됐거나 중단된 경우 등 제한적인 경우에만 가능했다. 또 고용자가 노동법을 위반한 경우 부과되는 고용 제한 조치는 법 위반이 발생한 현장에만 국한되고 동일 고용자의 다른 현장에는 효력이 미치지 않아, 큰 효과가 없다는 지적이 많았다.)

Accordingly, the government has decided to allow employers to reassign foreign workers to other sites and to extend the application of employment restriction measures to all construction sites under the same employer. (이에 따라 정부는 고용자가 외국인 근로자를 다른 현장으로 재배치할 수 있게 하고, 고용 제한 조치도 동일 고용자의 모든 공사 현장에 대해 확대 적용하기로 했다.)

item.title: Song Young-gil apologizes for "Jeong Cheong-rae's goldfish IQ" remark... "Not the words to use for a comrade" (송영길, “정청래 붕어 IQ” 발언 사과...“동지에 쓸 말 아냐”)
item.description:
Song Young-gil apologizes for "Jeong Cheong-rae's goldfish IQ" remark... "Not the words to use for a comrade" (송영길, “정청래 붕어 IQ” 발언 사과...“동지에 쓸 말 아냐”)

Song Young-gil, a candidate in the upcoming Democratic Party of Korea leadership race, apologized for his previous day's remark in which he criticized fellow candidate Jeong Cheong-rae as having a "goldfish IQ." (더불어민주당 차기 당대표 선거에 출마한 송영길 후보가 정청래 후보를 ‘붕어 IQ’라고 비난한 전날 자신의 발언에 대해 사과했다.)

In a Facebook post on the 14th, Song said, "These were not the words to use for a comrade in the same party," adding, "I also express my regret to party members who may have felt uncomfortable." (송 후보는 14일 페이스북 글에서 “같은 당의 동지에게 쓸 말은 아니었다”면서 “마음 불편하셨을 당원 동지 여러분께도 유감의 뜻을 전한다”고 했다.)

Regarding the background of the "goldfish IQ" remark, Song said, "Candidate Jeong Cheong-rae has been claiming that 'the party, government, and presidential office agreed to define the last local elections as a victory.' However, in the final TV debate, he changed his words, saying it was the party and presidential office, not the party, government, and presidential office." He added, "My emotions flared up at the sight of him lying in the face of clear facts, and in that process, an excessive expression slipped out. Still, I regret that the language was too harsh." (송 후보는 ‘붕어 IQ’ 발언 경위에 대해 “정청래 후보는 그동안 ‘당·정·청이 협의해 지난 지방선거를 승리로 규정했다’고 주장했다”면서 “그런데 마지막 TV 토론에서는 당·정·청이 아니라 당·청이라고 했다며 말을 바꿨다”고 했다. 이어 “명백한 사실 앞에서 거짓말을 하는 모습에 감정이 격해졌고, 그 과정에서 과한 표현이 나왔다”면서 “그럼에도 표현이 거칠었던 것은 유감스럽게 생각한다”고 했다.)

The previous day, in a CBS radio interview, Song had criticized Jeong, saying, "The video is preserved as evidence, so why tell such an obvious lie? It's not like he has a goldfish IQ." At the time, Song said, "To lie, you need to be smart. You have to remember everything you said before, but since he can't remember, it's like he has a goldfish IQ." (송 후보는 전날 CBS라디오 인터뷰에서 정 후보를 향해 “영상이 박제가 돼 있는데 뻔한 거짓말을 왜 하느냐. 붕어 IQ도 아니고”라고 비난했다. 당시 송 후보는 “거짓말을 하려면 머리가 좋아야 한다”면서 “이전에 자기가 무슨 말을 하는지를 다 기억하고 있어야 하는데 그 기억을 못 하니까 붕어 IQ처럼”이라고 했다.)

In a Facebook post, Jeong fired back, saying, "Last time, he didn't hesitate to use extreme words like 'traitor' and 'cut off his head,' and now it's 'goldfish IQ'—isn't this going too far?" He added, "Did Kim Min-seok put him up to it? Or is this Song Young-gil's unique character?" (정 후보는 페이스북 글에서 “지난번에는 ‘역적’ ‘목 잘라야’라는 극언을 서슴지 않더니 이제 ‘붕어 IQ’까지, 이거 너무 심하지 않느냐”면서 “김민석이 시켰나? 아니면 송영길의 독특한 인간성인가”라고 맞받았다.)

item.title: People Power Party tells presidential office floating 4-year re-election system: "Stop attempting constitutional amendment for a change of pace" (野, 4년 중임 대통령제 띄운 靑에 “국면 전환용 개헌 시도 중단하라”)
item.description:
People Power Party tells presidential office floating 4-year re-election system: "Stop attempting constitutional amendment for a change of pace" ( 野, 4년 중임 대통령제 띄운 靑에 “국면 전환용 개헌 시도 중단하라”)

The People Power Party on the 14th responded to the presidential office floating discussions on a 4-year re-election presidential system, saying it aims to "complement the problems of the imperial presidency," by stating, "This is an attempt to break through the president's legal risks through a constitutional amendment" and "Stop the constitutional amendment attempt meant to change the narrative." (국민의힘은 14일 청와대가 제왕적 대통령제의 문제점을 보완하겠다며 4년 중임 대통령제 관련 논의를 띄운 데 대해 “대통령의 사법 리스크를 개헌으로 돌파하려는 것” “국면 전환용 개헌 시도를 중단하라”고 했다.)

People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk posted on his Facebook that afternoon, asking, "In our history, has there ever been an 'imperial' president like President Lee Jae-myung?" He added, "The presidential office's position on the constitutional amendment is that it empathizes with the problems of the imperial presidential-centered system." (국민의힘 장동혁 대표는 이날 오후 자신의 페이스북에 글을 올리고 “우리 역사에 이재명 대통령 같은 ‘제왕적’ 대통령이 있었느냐”고 했다. 그는 “제왕적 대통령 중심제가 가진 문제점에 공감하고 있다는 게 개헌에 대한 청와대 입장”이라며 이같이 말했다.)

He then said, "They tore down the entire judicial system of the Republic of Korea to eliminate their own trial," and "They ignore the public's voice on housing policy and stock market policy and do whatever they want. They are pushing through the abolition of supplementary investigative powers and the integration of military academies no matter how much the people oppose it." He continued, "I repeat, the precondition for a constitutional amendment is simple. President Lee Jae-myung should declare that he will serve only one term as president." (그러면서 “자기 재판 없애겠다고 대한민국 사법 체계를 몽땅 다 허물었다”며 “부동산 정책, 증시 정책, 국민의 목소리는 무시하고 하고 싶은 대로 다 한다. 보완 수사권 폐지, 사관학교 통합, 국민이 아무리 반대해도 밀어붙이고 있다”고 했다. 이어 “거듭 말하지만 개헌의 전제 조건은 간단하다. 이재명 대통령 스스로 대통령 한 번만 하겠다고 선언하면 된다”고 했다.)

Floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik also criticized, saying, "The presidential office is directly coming forward and openly pushing for a constitutional amendment for a re-election system." He said, "No matter what modifiers the presidential office attaches to the constitutional amendment—'power-sharing system,' 'problems of the imperial presidency,' 'strengthening National Assembly powers'—the essence is one," adding, "This is an attempt at a 'prison-break constitutional amendment' to break through the president's legal risks through constitutional revision." (정점식 원내대표도 “청와대가 직접 나서 중임제 개헌을 노골화하고 있다”고 비판했다. 그는 “청와대가 개헌 앞에 ‘분권형’이니, ‘제왕적 대통령제의 문제’니, ‘국회 권한 강화’니 하며 수식어를 갈아 끼워도 본질은 하나”라며 “대통령의 사법 리스크를 개헌으로 돌파하려는 ‘탈옥형 개헌’의 시도”라고 했다.)

Floor leader Jeong said, "If President Lee Jae-myung has even a trace of sincerity about a constitutional amendment, he should come before the people and first promise 'there will be no re-election' and 'I will stand trial immediately.'" He added, "Without such promises, any constitutional amendment discussions by the government and ruling party can receive no public trust and can seek no cooperation from any opposition party." (정 원내대표는 “이재명 대통령이 정말 개헌에 손톱만한 진정성이라도 있다면, 국민 앞에 나와서 ‘연임은 없다’ ‘당장 재판받겠다’는 약속부터 해야 한다”고 했다. 그러면서 “이런 약속이 없다면, 정부와 여당의 개헌 논의는 그 어떤 국민적 신뢰도 받을 수 없고 그 어떤 야당의 협조도 구할 수 없다”고 했다.)

Lawmaker Kim Jae-seop of the same party also posted on Facebook that day, saying, "Claiming that because the imperial presidency is a problem, we should switch to a 4-year re-election system is deceiving the people." He said, "They don't think about laying down the enormous powers they hold themselves—does touching only the term length solve the problem of the imperial presidency?" adding, "This is not correcting the imperial presidency. It is turning the imperial presidency into a 4-year re-election monarchy." (같은 당 김재섭 의원도 이날 자신의 페이스북에 “제왕적 대통령제가 문제니까 4년 중임제로 바꾸자는 건 국민 기만”이라고 했다. 그는 “스스로 가진 비대한 권한을 내려놓을 생각은 하지 않고, 임기만 건드린다고 제왕적 대통령제 문제가 해결되느냐”며 “이건 제왕적 대통령제를 바로잡는 것이 아니다. 제왕적 대통령제를 4년 중임 군주제로 바꾸자는 것”이라고 했다.)

People Power Party senior spokesperson Park Choong-kwon said, "A constitutional amendment is not a 'card for changing the narrative' to be pulled out according to the political needs of a president or a particular administration," and "Immediately stop the 'tactical constitutional amendment attempt' to evade the administration's crisis and extend its power." (국민의힘 박충권 수석대변인은 “헌법 개정은 대통령이나 특정 정권의 정치적 필요에 따라 꺼내드는 ‘국면 전환용 카드’가 아니다”라며 “정권의 위기를 모면하고 권력을 연장하기 위한 ‘정략적 개헌 시도’를 즉각 중단하라”고 했다.)

Earlier, the presidential office stated regarding the direction of the power-structure constitutional amendment pursued by President Lee Jae-myung, "We believe a 4-year re-election presidential system with strengthened National Assembly powers has the highest public acceptability." A presidential office official told reporters that day, "Since the intention is to complement the limitations of the imperial presidency with a re-election presidential system, it is not a cabinet system," adding, "It also does not specify or refer to a power-sharing presidential system." (앞서 청와대는 이재명 대통령이 추구하는 권력 구조 개헌의 방향성과 관련해 “국회의 권한이 강화된 4년 중임 대통령제가 국민적 수용성이 가장 높다고 생각하고 있다”고 밝혔다. 청와대 관계자는 이날 기자들과 만나 “제왕적 대통령제의 한계를 중임제 대통령제로 보완하겠다는 것이므로, 내각제는 아니다”라며 “분권형 대통령제 등을 특정하거나 지칭하는 것도 아니다”라고 했다.)

item.title: Lee Jin-sook 'May 18 Re-examination Forum'... Ruling Party Submits Motion Calling for Expulsion (이진숙 ‘5·18 재조명 포럼’... 與, 제명 촉구 결의안 제출)
item.description:
Lee Jin-sook 'May 18 Re-examination Forum'... Ruling Party Submits Motion Calling for Expulsion (이진숙 ‘5·18 재조명 포럼’... 與, 제명 촉구 결의안 제출)

The Democratic Party of Korea submitted a motion on the 14th calling for the expulsion of Lee Jin-sook, a lawmaker from the People Power Party, who held a forum on the May 18 Gwangju Democratization Movement at the National Assembly alongside a right-wing group. (더불어민주당은 국회에서 우파 단체와 함께 5·18 광주 민주화운동에 관한 포럼을 개최한 이진숙 국민의힘 의원에 대한 제명 촉구 결의안을 14일 제출했다.)

The Democratic Party submitted the 'Motion Calling for the Expulsion of Lawmaker Lee Jin-sook for Distorting and Denigrating May 18' to the National Assembly Secretariat in the name of all its lawmakers that day. Rep. Park Gyun-taek, the deputy floor leader, and Rep. Lee Ju-hee, the floor spokesperson, who directly submitted the motion, told reporters, "This lawmaker must immediately step down from her position." (민주당은 이날 소속 국회의원 전원 명의로 ‘5·18 왜곡·폄훼 이진숙 국회의원 제명 촉구 결의안’을 국회사무처에 제출했다. 결의안을 직접 제출한 박균택 원내부대표와 이주희 원내대변인은 기자들과 만나 “이 의원은 당장 국회의원직에서 물러나야 한다”고 했다.)

Floor spokesperson Lee said, "She gathered figures who denigrate the spirit of May 18 and did not hesitate to deny even historically confirmed facts," adding, "She is unfit to be a lawmaker." Rep. Park also said, "Seeing her push ahead with the forum despite opposition from her own party, she is a substandard politician who cannot be reformed through rational means," adding, "We have no choice but to call for her expulsion." (이 원내대변인은 “이 의원은 5·18 정신을 폄훼하는 인사들을 모아 역사적으로 확정된 사실조차 부정하는 행위를 서슴지 않았다”면서 “국회의원으로서 자격이 없다”고 말했다. 박 의원도 “소속 정당에서도 반대했는데도 토론회를 강행하는 모습을 보면 합리적 방법으로는 개조가 불가능한 함량 미달 정치인”이라면서 “제명을 촉구할 수밖에 없다”고 했다.)

A motion to expel a lawmaker is brought to a plenary session after review by the National Assembly's Ethics Committee and consultation with the Ethics Advisory Council. If the expulsion is passed with the approval of two-thirds or more of lawmakers in a plenary session, the lawmaker loses their seat. However, the only actual case of expulsion was that of former President Kim Young-sam in 1979. Rep. Park said, "We should use this incident as an opportunity to quickly form the National Assembly Ethics Committee, which has not yet been constituted." (국회의원 제명안은 국회 윤리특별위원회의 심사와 윤리심사자문위원회의 의견 청취를 거치면 본회의에 상정된다. 본회의에서 국회의원 3분의 2 이상 찬성으로 제명 처분이 가결되면 해당 의원은 의원직을 상실한다. 다만 실제 제명이 이뤄진 사례는 1979년 김영삼 전 대통령이 유일하다. 박 의원은 “아직까지 구성되지 않고 있는 국회 윤리특위를 이번 사건을 계기로 빨리 구성해야 한다”고 했다.)

The previous day, Lee held the 'National Assembly Open Forum on Re-examining the May 18 Democratization Movement' jointly with the civic group New History National Movement at the National Assembly Library. At the forum, remarks were made describing the May 18 Gwangju Democratization Movement as a "riot." The Democratic Party strongly criticized this as a "historical coup." (이 의원은 전날 국회도서관에서 시민단체 새역사국민운동과 공동으로 ‘5·18 민주화운동의 재조명 국회 공개포럼’을 개최했다. 이 포럼에선 5·18 광주 민주화운동에 대해 “소요 사태”라는 등의 발언이 나왔다. 민주당은 이를 “역사 쿠데타”라며 강하게 비판했다.)

item.title: Oh Se-hoon Visits National Assembly, Criticizes Government Housing Measures as "Effectively Infringing on Citizens' Freedom of Residence and Movement" (국회 찾은 오세훈, 정부 부동산 대책에 “사실상 국민 거주 이전 자유 침해”)
item.description:
Oh Se-hoon Visits National Assembly, Criticizes Government Housing Measures as "Effectively Infringing on Citizens' Freedom of Residence and Movement" (국회 찾은 오세훈, 정부 부동산 대책에 “사실상 국민 거주 이전 자유 침해”)

Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon attended the floor strategy meeting of the People Power Party held at the National Assembly in Yeouido, Seoul, on the 14th, and criticized the government's August 13 housing supply policy. This marked an alignment on housing policy between the opposition party and local government heads affiliated with the opposition. However, some members of the pro-power faction leadership openly expressed dissatisfaction, asking, "Why is a local government head attending a floor strategy meeting?" (오세훈 서울시장이 14일 서울 여의도 국회에서 열린 국민의힘 원내대책회의에 직접 참석해 정부의 8·13 부동산 공급 정책을 비판했다. 야당과 야당 소속 지자체장이 부동산 정책 공조에 나선 것이다. 다만 일부 당권파 지도부는 “지자체장이 원내대책회의에 왜 참석하느냐”며 공개적으로 불만을 드러냈다.)

Mayor Oh stated that day regarding the government's housing policy, "This is effectively an infringement on the people's freedom of residence and movement." He added, "What matters most is fundamentally changing the direction of the government's housing policy," and stressed, "A full-scale review must begin with the obsession with actual residence requirements, which only increases the suffering of the people." (오 시장은 이날 정부의 부동산 정책에 대해 “사실상 국민의 거주 이전의 자유를 침해하는 것”이라고 했다. 이어 “무엇보다 중요한 것은 정부 부동산 정책의 방향을 근본적으로 바꾸는 것”이라며 “국민 고통을 키우는 실거주 집착 정책에서부터 전면 재검토가 이루어져야 한다”고 했다.)

He claimed that the Seoul Metropolitan Government was excluded from the government's policy announcement process the previous day. Mayor Oh said, "It is somewhat fortunate that some improvements to redevelopment project regulations were reflected in the government's housing measures," but added, "Excluding Seoul, which implements housing supply on the ground, from the policy decision-making process is not a desirable approach." (그는 전날 정부의 대책 발표 과정에서 서울시가 배제됐다고 주장했다. 오 시장은 “정부 부동산 대책에 정비 사업 규제 개선 사항이 일부 반영된 것은 그나마 다행”이라면서도 “주택 공급을 현장에서 집행하는 서울시를 정책 결정 과정에서 배제하는 방식은 바람직하지 않다”고 했다.)

Floor leader of the People Power Party, Chung Jin-suk, also commented on the government's announcement the previous day, saying, "They boast of a supply of over 1.5 million units, but 1.35 million of those are merely recycled from the LH-led public housing supply plan announced last year," and warned, "If they keep relying on recycled announcements and deceptive number games, no matter how good the measures are, they will inevitably lose the trust of the market and the people." (정점식 국민의힘 원내대표도 전날 정부의 발표에 대해 “150만호가 넘는 공급이라고 자랑하지만, 이 중 135만호는 작년에 발표했던 LH 주도의 공공주택 공급 계획을 재활용한 것”이라며 “재탕 발표에 눈속임용 숫자놀음으로 일관한다면 아무리 좋은 대책이라도 시장과 국민의 신뢰를 잃어버릴 수밖에 없다”고 했다.)

It is unusual for a local government head to attend the party's floor strategy meeting. On this day, Mayor Oh attended the party meeting at the invitation of Floor Leader Chung Jin-suk and was given the floor second, right after Floor Leader Chung. (지자체장이 당의 원내대책회의에 참석한 것은 이례적이다. 이날 오 시장은 정점식 원내대표의 초청으로 당 회의에 참석해 정 원내대표에 이어 두 번째 순서로 발언권을 얻었다.)

However, some lawmakers voiced criticism during this process. Secretary-General Chung Hee-yong said before the meeting began, "Is there any precedent of bringing in a local government head to attend a floor strategy meeting?" and added, "You should either have them speak first and then leave, or arrange a separate setting—what is this all about?" (다만 이 과정에서 일부 의원의 비판의 목소리도 나왔다. 정희용 사무총장은 회의 시작 전 “단체장을 불러가지고 원내 대책 회의에 (참석시키는 사례가) 어디 있느냐”며 “먼저 (발언을) 하고 나가라고 하든지, 다른 자리를 만들든지 해야지 뭐 하는 거냐”고 했다.)

Secretary-General Chung, without responding to Floor Leader Chung Jin-suk, who approached him with a greeting that day, simply took his seat. When the Floor Leader patted him on the back, he protested, saying, "This really makes no sense, Leader." When his turn to speak came, he said, "I will substitute today's remarks with the materials distributed in advance." (정 총장은 이날 인사를 건네며 다가온 정점식 원내대표에게 대꾸하지 않고 자리에 앉았다. 정 원내대표가 등을 두드리자 “말이 안 됩니다 진짜 이거는 대표님”이라고 항의했다. 자신의 발언 차례에서는 “오늘 발언은 사전 배부해 드린 자료로 대신하겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: Election Commission Special Counsel Recommendation Committee Recommends Lee Tae-han and Lee Hyuk as Special Counsel Candidates (선관위 특검 추천위, 특검 후보로 이태한·이혁 추천)
item.description:
The National Recommendation Committee for the 'Special Counsel for the National Election Commission,' tasked with investigating the ballot shortage incident during the June 3 local elections, decided on the 14th to select Lee Hyuk, former prosecutor at the Seoul High Prosecutors' Office, and Lee Tae-han, former head prosecutor at the Seoul Southern District Prosecutors' Office, as special counsel candidates. At its second meeting held at the National Assembly that day, the National Recommendation Committee decided to finalize its recommendation of Lee Hyuk and Lee Tae-han to President Lee Jae-myung from among six candidates proposed by the Korean Bar Association and the Council of Law School Deans. <<> Both Lee Hyuk and Lee Tae-han are 'special investigation veterans' with experience in special investigations at the prosecution service. Lee Hyuk previously worked on the special counsel team investigating the 'corruption allegations surrounding associates of former President Roh Moo-hyun,' while Lee Tae-han served as the head of the special investigation department at the Ulsan District Prosecutors' Office. <<> Earlier, the Korean Bar Association recommended three individuals to the National Recommendation Committee: former prosecutor Lee Hyuk, former head prosecutor Lee Tae-han, and Lee Geum-gyu, a special counsel investigator for the Marine death special counsel. The Council of Law School Deans separately recommended three others: Lim Gwan-hyuk, former chief prosecutor of the Seoul High Prosecutors' Office; Kim Yang-su, former deputy chief prosecutor of the Busan High Prosecutors' Office; and Seo Jeong-sik, former head of the Seongnam Branch Office. The National Recommendation Committee narrowed these down to two and submitted its written recommendation to President Lee. The President will then make the final appointment of one of the two as special counsel. <<> The National Recommendation Committee stated, "We comprehensively reviewed whether the candidates could conduct an independent and fair investigation into the alleged infringement of citizens' political rights, including the ballot shortage incident, and whether they possessed the expertise required to carry out the duties of a special counsel." (6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태 등을 수사하기 위한 ‘선거관리위원회 특별검사’ 국민추천위원회가 14일 특검 후보로 이혁 전 서울고검 검사와 이태한 전 서울남부지검 부장검사를 결정했다. 국민추천위는 이날 국회에서 2차 회의를 열고, 대한변호사협회와 법학전문대학원협의회가 추천한 후보 6명 중 이혁·이태한 후보자를 이재명 대통령에게 최종 추천하기로 했다.)

item.title: "Sick and Tired of Prosecution Reform"...74% of Young Party Members Say "The Party Doesn't Listen to Our Voices" (“검찰개혁 지긋지긋”...與 청년당원 74% “당이 우리 목소리 안 들어” )
item.description:
A party-conducted survey taken ahead of the August 17 national convention of the Democratic Party of Korea found that roughly three out of four young paid-up members view the party as one that "does not genuinely listen to the voices of young people." Even as party leadership candidates are touting outreach to the 2030 generation as a key priority in this convention, a large share of young members expressed negative assessments of the party. (더불어민주당이 8·17 전당대회를 치르는 와중에 실시한 당 자체 조사에서 청년 권리당원 4명 중 3명가량이 민주당을 ‘청년의 목소리를 진심으로 듣지 않는 정당’이라고 평가한 것으로 나타났다. 당대표 후보들이 이번 전대에서 2030 청년층 공략을 주요 과제로 내세우고 있는 가운데 정작 청년 당원들에게서 당에 대한 부정적 평가가 대거 나온 것이다.)

According to an online youth perception survey released on the 14th by the youth and future affairs subcommittee of the party's national convention preparation committee, 74% of respondents answered "strongly disagree" or "disagree" to the statement, "The Democratic Party is currently a party that genuinely listens to the voices of young people." (14일 민주당 전당대회준비위원회 청년미래분과가 공개한 온라인 청년 인식 조사에 따르면 ‘지금 민주당은 청년의 목소리를 진심으로 듣는 정당이다’라는 질문에 응답자의 74%가 ‘매우 아니다’ 또는 ‘아니다’라고 답했다.)

Evaluations of internal decision-making and policy were also poor. In response to the questions, "Is this a party where young people can participate in decision-making?" and "Is this a party that understands the lives of young people and reflects them in policy?" 70% respectively gave negative answers. On the assessment, "A party that admits mistakes and changes course," 69% responded negatively, and 60% gave a negative response to the statement, "A party that always follows through on what it promises." (당내 의사 결정과 정책에 대한 평가도 좋지 않았다. ‘청년이 의사결정에 참여할 수 있는 정당인가’, ‘청년의 삶을 이해하고 정책에 반영하는 정당인가’라는 질문에 각각 70%가 부정적으로 답했다. ‘잘못했을 때 인정하고 바꾸는 정당’이라는 평가에는 69%, ‘말한 것은 반드시 실천하는 정당’이라는 평가에는 60%가 부정적 반응을 보였다.)

During the survey, young members submitted a total of 5,670 anonymous suggestions. A member in his 20s from Seoul said, "I'm really sick and tired of prosecution reform," while a member in his 30s from North Jeolla Province said, "Policy isn't just about judicial reform." A member in his 30s from Seoul said, "If you've done something wrong, please just admit it," and a member in his 30s from Gyeonggi Province called for "housing market stability." (조사 과정에서 청년 당원들이 남긴 익명 제안은 5670건에 달했다. 서울의 한 20대 당원은 “검찰개혁 정말 지긋지긋하다”고 했고, 전북의 30대 당원은 “정책이 무슨 사법개혁만 있는 게 아니다”라고 했다. 서울의 30대 당원은 “잘못했으면 제발 인정 좀 하라”고 했고, 경기 지역 30대 당원은 “부동산 안정”을 주문했다.)

Throughout this national convention, party leadership candidates have emphasized the 2030 generation. Candidate Kim Min-seok proposed building a "comprehensive youth platform" centered on the youth committee and college student committee, while Candidate Chung Chung-rae pledged the swift introduction of a 4.5-day workweek as part of his policy on youth employment and labor issues. Candidate Song Young-gil has also pursued young voters by holding 2030 youth meetings during the regional primary tours. (이번 전당대회에서 당대표 후보들은 2030 청년층을 강조해 왔다. 김민석 후보는 청년위원회·대학생위원회를 중심으로 한 ‘청년 종합 플랫폼’ 구성을 제안했고, 정청래 후보는 청년 일자리·노동 문제와 관련해 주 4.5일제의 조속한 도입을 공약했다. 송영길 후보도 순회경선 과정에서 2030 청년 간담회를 갖는 등 청년 표심 공략에 나섰다.)

The Democratic Party is also holding regional town hall meetings with 2030 young members during the convention period. At the main convention event on the 17th, a "final interview for party leader" is scheduled, in which candidates Kim Min-seok, Chung Chung-rae, and Song Young-gil will answer questions prepared by young members. The findings of this perception survey and opinions gathered from the regional town hall meetings will be reflected in the interview questions and in the youth policy agenda for the new leadership. (민주당도 이번 전대 기간 2030 청년 당원들과 권역별 타운홀 미팅을 진행하고 있다. 오는 17일 전당대회 본행사에서는 김민석·정청래·송영길 후보가 청년들이 만든 질문에 답하는 ‘당대표 최종면접’도 예정돼 있다. 이번 인식 조사 결과와 권역별 타운홀 미팅에서 나온 의견도 면접 질문과 새 지도부의 청년 정책 과제에 반영될 예정이다.)

The survey was conducted online over roughly three weeks from the 23rd of last month to the 13th of this month, with 2,380 young paid-up members participating. (이번 조사는 지난달 23일부터 이달 13일까지 약 3주간 온라인으로 진행됐으며 청년 권리당원 2380명이 참여했다.)

item.title: Cheon Ha-ram, '40s Trainee': "I Thought I Was Going to Die... The Sacrifice of Our Soldiers Is Truly Remarkable" (‘40대 훈련병’ 천하람 “정말 죽는 줄...국군 장병 노고 대단”)
item.description:
Cheon Ha-ram, the floor leader of the Reform Party, who experienced a three-day, two-night basic training at the Army Training Center in Nonsan, South Chungcheong Province starting on the 12th, said on the 14th, "During the training, I really thought I was going to die," adding, "For me, it was just a brief moment, but the dedication of our soldiers defending the nation is truly remarkable." (지난 12일부터 충남 논산 육군훈련소에서 2박3일간 신병 교육을 체험한 천하람 개혁신당 원내대표가 14일 “훈련받을 때는 정말 죽는 줄 알았다”며 “저야 잠깐이고, 나라를 지키는 우리 국군 장병의 노고가 정말 대단하다”고 했다.)

Floor leader Cheon was assigned to the National Defense Committee for the second half of the 22nd National Assembly. Before entering the training center on the 12th, he had said, "I will personally experience the treatment and living conditions of our soldiers who quietly carry out their duties even in the scorching heat, and reflect that in future National Defense Committee activities and policy inquiries." This marks the first time an incumbent lawmaker has entered the Nonsan Army Training Center as a trainee. (천 원내대표는 22대 후반기 국회에서 국방위원회에 배치됐다. 지난 12일 입소에 앞서 “폭염 속에서도 나라를 위해 묵묵히 임무를 수행하는 국군 장병들의 처우와 생활 환경을 몸으로 겪어보고 향후 국방위 활동과 정책 질의에 반영할 것”이라고 했었다. 현역 국회의원이 논산 육군훈련소에 훈련병으로 입소한 것은 처음이다.)

On that day, Floor leader Cheon said on Facebook, "The training was tough, but wearing military uniforms and living collectively in this heat was no joke." He added, "Waking up at 3 a.m. and immediately focusing intensely on core tactical training like individual combat was impressive. During the hottest part of the day, they prevented heat-related illnesses with afternoon naps and personal maintenance, and the heat-response equipment and medical systems were fully operational, ensuring both safety and training outcomes." He continued, "Despite the heat and hardship, the camaraderie of helping each other was truly touching. Our young generation in their 20s is carrying out their assigned roles more diligently and faithfully than anyone. I respect all our soldiers." (천 원내대표는 이날 페이스북에서 “훈련도 힘들었지만 이 더위에 군복 입고 단체 생활하는 것 자체가 장난이 아니었다”고 했다. 그는 “새벽 3시에 기상해 곧바로 각개전투 등 핵심 전술 훈련에 고강도로 집중하는 모습이 인상적이었다”며 “가장 뜨거운 낮 시간대에는 오침과 개인정비로 온열 질환을 예방하되, 폭염 대응 장비와 의료 체계가 충실히 가동돼 안전과 훈련 성과를 모두 챙기고 있었다”고 했다. 이어 “덥고 힘든 상황에서도 서로 돕는 전우애를 발휘해 정말 뭉클했다”며 “우리 20대 젊은 세대는 누구보다 착실하고 충실하게 맡겨진 역할을 잘 수행하고 있다. 모든 장병 여러분 존경스럽다”고 했다.)

Floor leader Cheon also said, "Training schedules, assembly times, and physical fitness test results were guided and recorded via smartwatches," adding, "With the excessive paperwork and the burden of relaying and disseminating information gone, both officers and drill instructors were highly satisfied, and the trainees' satisfaction was also very high." He went on, "From what I felt, having air conditioning in all the barracks at the training center is a truly welcome change. The training center cafeteria is also operated by professional contractors rather than cooks from the ranks. The food was good, and trainee satisfaction was high." He added, "Some training battalions haven't yet introduced smartwatches, but they're expected to do so soon. I'll also make sure the budget comes through properly." (천 원내대표는 또 “훈련 일정·집합 시간·체력 측정 결과 등이 스마트워치로 안내·기록되고 있었다”며 “과도한 서류 작업과 전달, 전파 부담이 사라져서 간부와 조교의 만족도도 높고 훈련병들의 만족도도 매우 높았다”고 했다. 이어 “체감으로는 훈련소 모든 생활관에 에어컨이 있는 것이 정말 바람직한 변화로 느껴졌다”며 “훈련소 식당도 취사병이 아닌 전문 업체가 위탁 운영한다. 맛도 좋고 훈련병들 만족도도 높았다”고 했다. 그러면서 “아직 스마트워치 도입이 안 된 교육 연대도 일부 있었는데, 곧 도입 예정이라고 한다”며 “예산이 무사히 나오는지 저도 챙기겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: South Korean PM Discusses SMRs with Bill Gates... Gates: "Korea's Nuclear Capabilities Will Contribute to the SMR Ecosystem" (韓총리·빌 게이츠 SMR 논의… 게이츠 “한국 원전 역량, SMR 생태계 기여할 것”)
item.description:
Prime Minister Han Duck-soo met with Bill Gates, co-founder of Microsoft and founder of next-generation nuclear company TerraPower, on the 14th to discuss cooperation on small modular reactors (SMRs). (한성숙 국무총리가 마이크로소프트 공동 창업자이자 차세대 원전 기업 테라파워 창업자인 빌 게이츠 게이츠재단 이사장을 14일 만나 소형 모듈형 원자로(SMR) 관련 협력 방안을 논의했다.)

According to the Office of the Prime Minister, PM Han met with Chairman Gates, who arrived in South Korea the previous day, at the government complex in Seoul for approximately 30 minutes of conversation. (국무총리실에 따르면, 한 총리는 전날 방한한 게이츠 이사장을 이날 오후 정부서울청사에서 만나 30분가량 대화했다.)

PM Han said, "Korea is pursuing three mega projects in response to the era of AI (artificial intelligence) transformation," adding, "A stable power supply is crucial to support these efforts." She also noted, "We are exploring an 'energy mix' (combining various energy sources) that utilizes renewables and SMRs." (한 총리는 “한국이 AI(인공지능) 대전환 시대를 맞이해 3대 메가 프로젝트를 추진하고 있다”고 소개하면서 “이를 뒷받침하기 위해 전력 공급이 매우 중요하다”고 했다. 그러면서 “재생에너지와 SMR을 활용하는 ‘에너지 믹스’(다양한 에너지원을 조합하는 것)를 모색하고 있다”고 했다.)

PM Han continued, "I highly value the cooperation between TerraPower and Korean companies and research institutions in the next-generation SMR field, spanning the entire cycle from investment to manufacturing and construction." (한 총리는 이어 “차세대 SMR 분야에서 테라파워와 한국 기업, 연구 기관이 투자부터 제작, 건설에 이르기까지 전 주기에 걸쳐 협력하고 있는 점을 높이 평가한다”고 했다.)

Chairman Gates responded, "I resonate with the Korean government's efforts to respond to the shift in the energy paradigm." (게이츠 이사장은 “에너지 패러다임 변화에 대응하기 위한 한국 정부의 노력에 공감한다”고 화답했다.)

Chairman Gates further said, "Korea has experience accumulated through the construction and operation of nuclear power plants, along with the capability to execute challenging large-scale projects, which will greatly contribute to achieving global carbon neutrality and building an innovative SMR ecosystem in the future." He added, "I will further strengthen strategic partnerships with Korean companies." (게이츠 이사장은 이어 “한국은 원전 건설과 운영을 통해 쌓아 온 경험과 어려운 대형 사업을 구현해 내는 역량이 있어, 향후 글로벌 탄소 중립 달성과 혁신 SMR 생태계 조성에 크게 기여할 것”이라며 “한국 기업과의 전략적 파트너십을 한층 강화해 나가겠다”고 했다.)

It was reported that Chairman Gates explained in detail to PM Han how critical the role of SMRs is in addressing climate change. (게이츠 이사장은 한 총리에게 기후 변화에 대응하는 데서 SMR의 역할이 얼마나 중요한지를 상세히 설명한 것으로 전해졌다.)

TerraPower, founded by Chairman Gates in 2008, has developed a reactor that uses liquid sodium as a coolant instead of water, and in March received approval from the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) to build commercial SMRs using this reactor design. (게이츠 이사장이 2008년 창업한 테라파워는 냉각재로 물이 아닌 액체 나트륨을 사용하는 원자로를 개발했고, 지난 3월 미국 원자력규제위원회(NRC)로부터 이 노형으로 상업용 SMR을 건설해도 된다는 허가를 받았다.)

The Office of the Prime Minister stated, "The government has established the legal foundation for fostering the SMR industry through the enactment of the Special Act on SMRs," and "We plan to improve the regulatory framework centered on large-scale reactors to encompass SMRs, support the development of various SMR types, and actively back the early commercialization of SMRs." (총리실은 “정부는 SMR 특별법 제정을 통해 SMR 산업 육성의 법적 기반을 마련했다”며 “대형 원전 중심의 규제 체계를 SMR까지 포괄할 수 있도록 개선하고, 다양한 SMR 유형 개발을 지원해 SMR의 조기 상용화를 적극 뒷받침할 계획”이라고 밝혔다.)

item.title: Kim Yong "Hopes for Early Lame-Duck Status of President Chung Chung-rae" (김용 “정청래 대통령 조기 레임덕 바라나”)
item.description:
Kim Yong, a candidate for the Supreme Council member of the Democratic Party of Korea, criticized the controversy surrounding Lee Jin-suk, a lawmaker from the People Power Party, over her disparagement of the May 18 Democratization Movement, saying, "They are exploiting the cracks in the Democratic Party to mislead the youth and voters." <<> Candidate Kim held a press conference at the National Assembly in Yeouido, Seoul, on the 14th and said, "The lawmaker's press conference took place right here just a moment ago," adding, "They call May 18 a 'riot.' This is how the remnants of the far-right insurrection are stirring." <<> Candidate Kim said, "This is not the time for the Democratic Party to be doing this," and "This is the time to unite tightly around President Lee Jae-myung. We must surely fulfill the people's mission." He then added, "If you make ordinary member Kim Yong a Supreme Council member of the Democratic Party, I will stand at the forefront and fight with my whole body." <<> Candidate Kim said, "Today's Gallup poll is shocking," and "In the president's approval rating for state affairs, negative responses have surpassed positive ones." He continued, "Party leader candidate Chung Chung-rae says the president's approval rating is falling because the hearts of traditional supporters have cooled, so I am deeply concerned that it is not the People Power Party but Candidate Chung who is hoping for the president's early lame-duck status." <<> He then said, "Are they trying to reorganize the Democratic Party around Chung Chung-rae instead of Lee Jae-myung?" and "What Team Chung Chung-rae wants is not the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration, but for themselves to seize the next power." <<> Regarding the allegations of bullying and sexual harassment surrounding Lee Sung-yoon, a candidate for Supreme Council member, he said, "Party members have not yet heard any explanation," and "Once I become a Supreme Council member, I will push for a party-level fact-finding investigation." <<> In response, Candidate Lee maintains the position that the allegations are "groundless." In a recent Facebook post, he said, "Baseless negative campaigning and spreading false information are no different from Ilbe," and "I will take full legal action against all malicious instigation acts that interfere with the election." He added, "I have already filed a lawsuit, and additional legal proceedings are underway," and "I will surely hold them accountable to the end." <<> With candidates Kim Min-seok and Chung Chung-rae engaged in a fierce competition for the party leadership, attention is also focused on the results of the Supreme Council member election, which selects five members. With two candidates each from the pro-Myung and pro-Chung factions competing, candidates Kim Yong (pro-Myung) and Lee Sung-yoon (pro-Chung) are battling for the final winning spot in fifth place. (김용 더불어민주당 최고위원 후보가 이진숙 국민의힘 의원의 5·18 민주화운동 폄훼 논란에 대해 “그들은 민주당의 균열을 틈타 청년과 유권자들을 호도하고 있다”고 비판했다.)
